scope: Eleven mocked lifecycle safety/control-flow cases only.
review: Strict VM dependency allowlists replace database, process, network and private fixture access. Real filesystem reads are limited to the named helper definitions.
Child environment contains only required OS variables plus NODE_ENV=test. Exclusive attempt01 output, 60-second timeout, bounded output, raw TAP and stderr plus exit diagnostics retained.
All five source hashes are captured before and after; pass requires exact 11/11 counts, zero failed/skipped, exit zero without launcher error, and unchanged sources.
Ownership/start/target/client mismatches prohibit termination; failed cleanup or native inspection remains failed while independently owned exclusive shutdown may proceed.
limitations: This is mocked control flow, not a native database or real process-lifecycle qualification.
No application, build, migration, browser or production operation is admitted.
